build-attestation.signed_by: trusted workflow step `attestation` (CI build facts + artifact digests)

release-signing.signed_by: trusted workflow step `release-signature` (release artifact/certificate class; binds the build-attestation bytes)

faktor-ci-build.notes: Build role only. This is the pre-existing build key migrated off the shared `faktor-ci`/`faktor` identity names; it MUST NOT sign release signatures or be reused as the release key. Rotated by replacing the `faktor_attest_signing_key` secret and this public key in one commit (scripts/woodpecker/setup.md §4.3).

faktor-release-signing.notes: Operator-provisioned release role. No private key exists in the repository; generate it on the operator machine with `node scripts/certification/attestation.mjs keygen --role release-signing --out-key release.pem --out-keys release-keys.json`, register the private key as the trusted-project secret `faktor_release_signing_key`, and paste ONLY the public key here per scripts/woodpecker/setup.md §4.2. Until then every release-class verification fails closed with the typed `signature-role-key-missing` refusal.
